record.bible_text: In that day<WH03117> there shall be a fountain<WH04726> opened<WH06605><WTH8737> to the house<WH01004> of David<WH01732> and to the inhabitants<WH03427><WTH8802> of Jerusalem<WH03389> for sin<WH02403> and for uncleanness<WH05079>. <RF>uncleanness: Heb. separation for uncleanness<Rf>

And it shall come to pass in that day<WH03117>, saith<WH05002><WTH8803> the LORD<WH03068> of hosts<WH06635>, <FI>that<Fi> I will cut off<WH03772><WTH8686> the names<WH08034> of the idols<WH06091> out of the land<WH0776>, and they shall no more be remembered<WH02142><WTH8735>: and also I will cause the prophets<WH05030> and the unclean<WH02932> spirit<WH07307> to pass<WH05674><WTH8686> out of the land<WH0776>.

And it shall come to pass, <FI>that<Fi> when any<WH0376> shall yet prophesy<WH05012><WTH8735>, then his father<WH01> and his mother<WH0517> that begat<WH03205><WTH8802> him shall say<WH0559><WTH8804> unto him, Thou shalt not live<WH02421><WTH8799>; for thou speakest<WH01696><WTH8765> lies<WH08267> in the name<WH08034> of the LORD<WH03068>: and his father<WH01> and his mother<WH0517> that begat<WH03205><WTH8802> him shall thrust<WH01856><WTH8804> him through when he prophesieth<WH05012><WTH8736>.

And it shall come to pass in that day<WH03117>, <FI>that<Fi> the prophets<WH05030> shall be ashamed<WH0954><WTH8799> every one<WH0376> of his vision<WH02384>, when he hath prophesied<WH05012><WTH8736>; neither shall they wear<WH03847><WTH8799> a rough<WH08181> garment<WH0155> to deceive<WH03584><WTH8763>: <RF>a rough...: Heb. a garment of hair<Rf> <RF>deceive: Heb. lie<Rf>

But he shall say<WH0559><WTH8804>, I <FI>am<Fi> no prophet<WH05030>, I <FI>am<Fi> an husbandman<WH0376><WH05647><WTH8802><WH0127>; for man<WH0120> taught me to keep cattle<WH07069><WTH8689> from my youth<WH05271>.

And <FI>one<Fi> shall say<WH0559><WTH8804> unto him, What <FI>are<Fi> these wounds<WH04347> in thine hands<WH03027>? Then he shall answer<WH0559><WTH8804>, <FI>Those<Fi> with which I was wounded<WH05221><WTH8717> <FI>in<Fi> the house<WH01004> of my friends<WH0157><WTH8764>.<CM>

Awake<WH05782><WTH8798>, O sword<WH02719>, against my shepherd<WH07462><WTH8802>, and against the man<WH01397> <FI>that is<Fi> my fellow<WH05997>, saith<WH05002><WTH8803> the LORD<WH03068> of hosts<WH06635>: smite<WH05221><WTH8685> the shepherd<WH07462><WTH8802>, and the sheep<WH06629> shall be scattered<WH06327><WTH8799>: and I will turn<WH07725><WTH8689> mine hand<WH03027> upon the little ones<WH06819><WTH8802>.

And it shall come to pass, <FI>that<Fi> in all the land<WH0776>, saith<WH05002><WTH8803> the LORD<WH03068>, two<WH08147> parts<WH06310> therein shall be cut off<WH03772><WTH8735> <FI>and<Fi> die<WH01478><WTH8799>; but the third<WH07992> shall be left<WH03498><WTH8735> therein.

And I will bring<WH0935><WTH8689> the third part<WH07992> through the fire<WH0784>, and will refine<WH06884><WTH8804> them as silver<WH03701> is refined<WH06884><WTH8800>, and will try<WH0974><WTH8804> them as gold<WH02091> is tried<WH0974><WTH8800>: they shall call<WH07121><WTH8799> on my name<WH08034>, and I will hear<WH06030><WTH8799> them: I will say<WH0559><WTH8804>, It <FI>is<Fi> my people<WH05971>: and they shall say<WH0559><WTH8799>, The LORD<WH03068> <FI>is<Fi> my God<WH0430>.<CM>
